definitions.explanation: A long rectangular wallet sized to hold paper currency flat without folding it. Contrasts with the more compact {折|お}り{畳|たた}み{財布|ざいふ} (folding wallet).

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{茶色|ちゃいろ}の{長財布|ながさいふ}を{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: My father uses a brown long wallet.

examples.japanese: {長財布|ながさいふ}は{札|さつ}が{折|お}れないので{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: Long wallets are convenient because the bills don't get folded.

examples.japanese: {誕生日|たんじょうび}に{革製|かわせい}の{長財布|ながさいふ}をプレゼントしてもらった。
examples.english: I was given a leather long wallet as a birthday present.

notes:
Compound of {長|なが}い (long) + {財布|さいふ} (wallet). Traditionally seen as a more formal or businesslike choice than a folding wallet because it keeps bills uncreased.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {革|かわ}の{長財布|ながさいふ}: leather long wallet
- {長財布|ながさいふ}を{使|つか}う: to use a long wallet
- {長財布|ながさいふ}を{持|も}つ: to carry a long wallet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {財布|さいふ}: wallet (general term)
- {折|お}り{畳|たた}み{財布|ざいふ}: folding wallet
- がま{口|ぐち}: clasp-style coin purse
